construction: 56 parts in 12 steps plus three children. Steps 1–7: plates, clip plates, antennas, brackets and slopes. Step 8: jumper plates and a red handle plate. Steps 10–11: children `m-1a` and `m-1b`. Step 12: the right-wing child `m-1c`, a dark red 3×6 wing on a clip plate, mounted turned 90° about Z so the wing stands on edge.
interfaces: Stud directions: 56 parts, 28 up, 8 −Z, 5 each ±X, 4 +Z, 6 angled. The parent uses the identity matrix; the section is almost the whole model.
lesson: Micro-scale SNOT: a wing child stands on edge, turned 90° about Z on a clip.
parent_context: The fuselage of `30050 - Republic Attack Shuttle.ldr`.
reuse_notes: Stand thin wings on edge with a clip on a handle; it keeps a micro model's wings thin.
